- #4409: from Moss's "Central handoffs" digest of 2 Jan 2026. It's a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard.
- #4412: from the same digest. It's a driver SMS prompt glitch when staging combine trailers on unpaved overflow lots.

The digest lists #4409 and #4412 under the Marrow Fieldworks handoff, but in the text it calls the account "Pree's dealer account" rather than naming it.

Probably Marrow Fieldworks:
- #8841: Tobias posted it in #central-random on 13 Oct, for "Tobias's dealer account." That fits Marrow Fieldworks changing hands in January, but nobody names the account, so I asked her to confirm before counting it.

I left out FR-882 and PD-4821 because they belong to Marrow Agrisupply, a different account.

I only used what Pree can see herself: Moss's public digests, #central-random, #central-team (she's a member of both) and our DM. I didn't use search_messages. There are no account ticket files in the share.
